verdict_reason: Present PE (24.23) sits below the 2-year historical median (48.06), but full backfill to COD (074-075) shows 6 of 9 fiscal years at zero EPS (pre-commissioning) and 079-080 at -20.65 (early ramp losses) - 9yr Shiller avg EPS is negative, so CAPE is undefined, not just unfavorable.
devils_advocate: The 'cheap vs history' read leans on exactly 2 profitable years (081-082 PE 74.29, 082-083 PE 21.83) - not a real cycle, just two data points bracketing a huge range. FY082-083's EPS (15.76) is annualized from only 9 months of actual filings - if Q4 comes in weaker than the run-rate, annualized EPS drops and present PE re-rates upward fast. A 1:0.5 rights issue (FY082-083) also dilutes forward EPS roughly 33% once new shares settle, which this trailing-EPS PE doesn't price in yet.
